title: Warranty Coverage Trip Rate for CareLine Service Plans Members
content:
**Clause.** For a technician visit whose trip charge Warranty Coverage bills, the trip rate of an owner who holds a CareLine plan is set as follows:

- An owner who holds an **active CareLine plan whose waiting period had ended by the date of the visit** and whose plan has **free trips left in the plan year of the visit** — meaning fewer repair and glass replacement visits logged in that plan year than the plan's free trips per plan year — uses one of those free trips, and **the trip rate is zero**.
- An owner who holds such a CareLine plan with **no free trips left** in that plan year has a trip rate equal to **the lower of the CareLine plan's own trip fee and the standard trip charge**.
- For every other owner no member trip rate applies.

Plan years are counted from the CareLine plan's enrolled date, the first twelve months being plan year one.

## Terms

- **CareLine plan**: any plan of the CareLine Service Plans other than the On-Call Service Account — the CareLine Basic, Plus, Premier, Premier 3-Year or Estate Plan — with active status on the CareLine Service Plans records. An On-Call Service Account is not a CareLine plan.
- **Waiting period ended by the date of the visit**: the visit is dated after the last day of the CareLine plan's waiting period, counted from its enrolled date.
- **Visits that use the free trips**: repair visits and glass replacement visits logged on the CareLine Service Plans records in the plan year of the visit.
- **Standard trip charge**: the Warranty Coverage plan's no-defect trip charge when the technician found no covered defect, otherwise its out-of-term trip charge.

## Cases (hypothetical figures; standard trip charge 100.00)

| CareLine holding | Repair and glass visits logged this plan year | Free trips per plan year | CareLine trip fee | Trip rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| active plan, past waiting period | 1 | 2 | 66.00 | zero |
| active plan, past waiting period | 2 | 2 | 66.00 | 66.00 |
| active plan, past waiting period | 3 | 2 | 140.00 | 100.00 |
| active plan, visit inside the waiting period | — | — | — | no member trip rate |
| On-Call Service Account | — | — | — | no member trip rate |

A visit 14 months after the enrolled date falls in plan year two, so only visits logged in plan year two count toward that year's free trips.
